info.name: Apple App Store Connect Apps API

description.content:
Automate the tasks you perform on the Apple Developer website and in App Store Connect. The App Store Connect API is a REST API that enables the automation of actions you take in App Store Connect, including managing apps, builds, beta testers, provisioning, and more. This specification covers the Apps, Builds, and Beta Testers resource groups.

 Email: developer@apple.com
